transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer billing, my name is Emma. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Emma. I've just started a new job where I get paid on the twenty-sixth of the month, and I'd like to adjust my direct debit payment date from the twelfth to the twenty-eighth so my bills align cleanly with my payday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I would be more than happy to help you adjust your direct debit schedule, Harper. Congratulations on the new role! Let me start with security verification. What is your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Harper Evans, 51 Church Street, Chester, CH1 2DJ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the security PIN on your account, Harper?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Harper, verification is complete. So what I understand is you want to change your recurring direct debit collection date from the twelfth of each month to the twenty-eighth to match your new employer's payday, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I want to make sure I don't get any failed payment fees while transitioning between pay dates.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What bank or building society is your existing direct debit mandate registered with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is with Barclays Bank, sort code 20-24-00.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And would you like the new payment date to take effect starting with your upcoming November invoice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, starting in November would be ideal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a moment while I access the BACS mandate scheduler in our billing portal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Harper. I am in the automated payment schedule manager.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will changing the date cause an unusually large bill due to pro-rata days?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a very sensible question. Because we are moving your billing cycle sixteen days later in the month, your November statement will show a small pro-rata adjustment for those extra sixteen days of broadband service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How much will that extra sixteen-day charge be approximately?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your monthly plan is thirty pounds, so sixteen days works out to exactly sixteen pounds, meaning your November invoice will be forty-six pounds, and subsequent months will revert to thirty pounds on the twenty-eighth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes total sense and is very easy to budget for.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of submitting the BACS mandate modification right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we are on your billing preferences, are you currently opted into paperless billing via PDF email?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, paperless billing is much more convenient for me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And would you like an SMS payment reminder dispatched three days before each direct debit collection?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would actually be really useful just as a quick heads up on payday weekend.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have enabled our free SMS billing reminder service for your mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's fantastic, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can download VAT receipts directly from the billing archive on our mobile app anytime.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know if I ever need proof of address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And your contract renewal date remains unchanged in March twenty twenty-seven.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, no change to contract length.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And if the twenty-eighth ever falls on a bank holiday or weekend, BACS rules state the payment will process on the following Monday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood, standard banking clearing rules apply.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And if you ever need to change your bank details in future, you can do that directly inside the My S-Net portal under Payment Methods.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know I don't necessarily have to call in every time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the self-service portal handles direct debit swaps securely in about sixty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's very convenient.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And our direct debit guarantee protects all payments against any unauthorized charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The Direct Debit Guarantee is always reassuring.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Emma.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before I commit the change, the direct debit is drawn from your Barclays account ending in 4920, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, account ending in 4920.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Submitting BACS change request... The schedule modification has been accepted with BACS reference BAC-88219.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Has the direct debit date updated in the system?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your recurring collection date is now set to the twenty-eighth of every calendar month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will I receive written confirmation of this direct debit change?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously BACS regulations require us to send a formal Direct Debit Advance Notice letter, which has just been dispatched to your email address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check my email on my phone right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! The email from S-Net Billing just arrived: 'Notice of Direct Debit Schedule Change - New collection date 28th of the month'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can see that the new collection date of twenty-eighth is confirmed on that notice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it shows the Barclays mandate and the 28th collection date clearly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your contact telephone number on file, it's 07700 900628, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your bills or broadband contract that I can assist you with today, Harper?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Emma, you made that so smooth and explained the pro-rata charge clearly. Thank you so much!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net, Harper, and best of luck in the new job!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Emma, goodbye.
